backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor defining user profiles, availability, posts, reactions, stats, and access-controlled query functions using various maps and mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented chat-related features, associated files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of key frontend React components, pages, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base layer defining light/dark theme variables and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point configuring metadata, PWA manifest, icons, and script loader for the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, start URL, display mode, theme colors, and icons.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page with basic styling and reconnect button.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing caching, precache assets, offline fallback, and network-first strategies.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the main app router and authentication gate, managing identity loading, profile fetching, and error handling before rendering routes.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Displays an access denied message for restricted admin pages with a button to return to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Provides the login UI using Internet Identity with branded styling and a sign-in button.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Renders the app logo using branding config and an optional className.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Implements the main group chat panel with message listing, posting, image uploads, and threaded view support.
frontend/src/components/chat/ImageAttach: Handles image selection, validation, preview, and clearing for chat message attachments.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReactionCon: Manages like/dislike reactions on posts with optimistic UI updates and backend mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/chat/ReplyCompos: Provides a reply input form with optional image upload and submit/cancel actions for threaded posts.
frontend/src/components/chat/ThreadedPos: Renders a recursive threaded post tree with avatars, reactions, replies, and indentation based on depth.
frontend/src/components/common/ErrorStat: Shows an error alert with a message and optional retry or secondary action buttons.
frontend/src/components/common/LoadingSt: Provides full‑page and inline loading spinners with optional message and size control.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with top bar, navigation, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Displays a navigation bar with route buttons and optional admin link based on user role.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageLayou: Provides page container with configurable max‑width and a header component with title and optional action.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Shows the top bar with app branding, theme toggle, PWA install actions, and user menu.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Displays and allows editing of a user's profile info including name and profile picture upload.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Shows the caller's all‑time leaderboard rank with loading state handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Renders the user's match history with loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: A modal prompting new users to enter their name and save their initial profile.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallInstr: Dialog component showing platform-specific PWA installation steps for iOS and non‑iOS users.
frontend/src/components/pwa/OfflineBanne: Banner that detects offline status and displays an alert when the user loses connectivity.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wrapper component that renders a fixed, low‑opacity background image behind page content.
Displays a user's avatar and name, falling back to initials or a principal-derived ID when needed.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks to fetch and update the caller's user profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Hooks to fetch the caller's user role and check admin status via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth client management, login state, and identity restoration across reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Manages PWA installation availability, platform detection, and triggering the install prompt.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, availability, leaderboard data, and related backend queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Hook that manages light/dark theme state synced with localStorage and document classes.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch user display names and avatars by principal, with fallbacks for missing profiles.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, CSS variables for themes, layout rules, and mobile safe-area handling.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports static branding info including app name and logo metadata.
frontend/src/lib/chatThreads.ts: Builds threaded post trees from flat lists and flattens them for rendering.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for converting dates to IDs, formatting dates/times, and generating month grids.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: UI page for creating or editing a user's availability with time selection and form submission.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard showing users and availabilities with delete actions and permission checks.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Renders a month-view calendar with navigation, availability indicators, and an embedded chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Displays a standalone group chat page with a header and full-height chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Shows availability details for a specific date, allowing users to add or delete their availability.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Displays player rankings, lets users record wins/losses for available days, and tracks rank changes.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Shows the user's profile card, leaderboard rank, and recent match history.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Provides helpers for reading files as bytes, generating name initials, and validating image uploads.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Supplies time formatting, parsing, and option utilities for availability input.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles reading, storing, and persisting URL parameters, including session-backed values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config extending theme colors, animations, and container settings, and enabling typography, container-query, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking chat overflow issues, existing mobile overflow-related features, and an in-progress fix request.
